items.title: Research Intern — DGPA UNAM
items.description: Curated documents for integration into OpenAI GPT chatbots and Gemini Gems. Using Python (Marker) and Bash (PDF Sandwich), I applied OCR to convert books and articles into Markdown text format, generated automatic transcripts of YouTube videos with Python (yt-dlp and Whisper), and created reports in Google Sheets.

items.title: Marketing Lead — SIAFI-UNAM
items.description: Coordinated the marketing team in the production and publication of social media content. I implemented collaborative workflows, asset standardization, and a ticketing system using Notion and Google Workspace.
